findings.issue: Private `IsNondegenerate.integral_floerEnergyDensity_image_endChart` (with its helper `integral_floerEnergyDensity_endChart_rect` at line 548) is a special case of the new public `SmoothTwoForm.IsNondegenerate.integral_floerEnergyDensity_image_realChart_Icc_prod_Ico`. It covers `f = q.cylindricalEndLift` on `Icc a₁ b₁ ×ˢ Ico (-1/2) (1/2)` with datum `β(±s - 1) H_q(t) dt`, and repeats the same three-integral change of variables (`integral_eval₂_mfderiv_stdComplexLine_image`, `integral_floerEnergyDensity_image`, `integral_hamiltonianCurvature_image`) followed by the rectangle identity.

summary: The prior duplicates of the periodic boundary lemma are removed, but the new public `IsNondegenerate.integral_floerEnergyDensity_image_realChart_Icc_prod_Ico` duplicates the private pair-of-pants rectangle identity in `PairOfPants/Curvature.lean`, which should now be derived from it. The rest of the PR reuses the existing change-of-variables, pullback and curvature-bound API.
